images.alt: Two arrangements side by side on a table. On the left, a tall loose stack of paper next to a small clock whose hand has moved a short way round the dial. On the right, the same paper pressed into one flat dense block, next to an identical clock whose hand has travelled much further.
images.prompt: Two side by side arrangements on a plain table top, centred in the frame with wide empty margins. On the left, a tall loose stack of paper sheets about a forearm high, and beside it a small round desk clock whose single hand points a short way round the dial. On the right, the same paper pressed into one flat dense block the height of a book, and beside it an identical clock whose hand has travelled most of the way round the dial. The two clocks sit at the same height so the two hands can be compared at a glance.
